Chapter 1225: 33: The Fate Of Shadow Demon And Nine Phoenix (Request For Subscription)_3

Chapter 1225: Chapter 33: The Fate of Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix (Request for Subscription)_3

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint heard this and did not respond.

Instead, continued to entangle with the Shadow Demon Great Saint.

“Fool.”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint was both angry and helpless.

…

Thousands of Void Domains away.

Lin Yuan gazed deeply, watching the entanglement between the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint from afar.

“I didn’t expect to encounter them here?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread.

After leaving the Xuanhuang Universe, Lin Yuan felt the Nine Phoenix Great Saint and the Shadow Demon Great Saint entangle in a fierce battle once more, without any reservations.

At that time, Lin Yuan indeed had the idea of pursuing them, but ultimately he gave it up.

One reason was that Lin Yuan gained enormously from his journey to the Xuanhuang Universe, obtaining the Sky Void Tripod, a Thirteenth Tier weapon, and did not want to complicate matters.

Secondly, even if he pursued and killed the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint, they wouldn’t truly die; they could ‘resurrect’ through life-saving means, rendering it meaningless.

So at that time, Lin Yuan didn’t pay much attention to it.

But now?

After stepping into the Chaos Realm, Lin Yuan’s strength still did not surpass the Xuanhuang, who had half-stepped out of the Twelfth Tier.

But the Nine Phoenix Great Saint and the Shadow Demon Great Saint were not peerless Great Saints, merely newly ascended Great Saints. Since Xuanhuang could completely slay peerless Great Saints, Lin Yuan could also try to thoroughly kill the newly ascended Great Saints like the Nine Phoenix Great Saint and the Shadow Demon Great Saint.

“Alright, let’s settle this cause and effect.”

Lin Yuan took a step forward and disappeared from where he was.

…

A clash of black and red aura.

The originally pursuer and pursued, Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint, suddenly felt the surrounding space-time shift and an unbearable pressure collapsing upon them.

“Who is it?”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint was filled with dread. Such pressure had already surpassed that of the Galaxy Great Saint.

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint also had a face full of vigilance.

At this moment.

A figure appeared out of thin air, quietly watching the two Chaos Great Saints.

“Galaxy Great Saint?”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint was speechless; he hadn’t felt any connection to the Galaxy Great Saint.

“Galaxy Great Saint?”

Compared to the Shadow Demon Great Saint, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was not so fearful.

At least in the hands of the Galaxy Great Saint, neither the Shadow Demon nor she could escape.

“Galaxy Great Saint, I don’t know when I offended you, I’m willing to make amends, paying any price to do so.”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint immediately said, though the loss of this physical body didn’t count as true death, continuously staying like this wasn’t a solution. To be enemies with such a powerful being as the Galaxy Great Saint made the Shadow Demon Great Saint feel unable to move forward.

“Make amends?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Shadow Demon Great Saint and smiled slightly, “No need.”

The next moment.

The Shadow Demon Great Saint started to feel his vision blur.

“What?”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint’s scalp prickled; in this instant, he sensed everything related to his cause and effect beginning to extinguish, including life-saving means and the like.

“Am I truly going to die?”

This thought suddenly floated up in the Shadow Demon Great Saint’s mind, and immediately he began to struggle, trying to break free a strand of his spiritual consciousness for ‘reincarnation.’

But next, the entirety of the Shadow Demon Great Saint’s mind and consciousness completely collapsed, everything related to his physical and spiritual form disappeared without a trace.

“Completely dead?”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly; just now, he had exerted himself fully, instantly locking onto everything related to the Shadow Demon Great Saint’s cause and effect and obliterated it all at once.

“Shadow Demon…..”

Beside him, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was in a daze, unsurprised by the Shadow Demon Great Saint’s fall.

With the strength the Galaxy Great Saint showed in the Xuanhuang Universe, it was quite normal to kill both of them, ordinary Great Saints as they were.

But what shocked the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was that after the Shadow Demon Great Saint’s death, there was indeed no source of cause and effect.

Considering the enmity and cause between her and the Shadow Demon Great Saint, as long as the Shadow Demon Great Saint was alive, she should have been able to sense his cause and effect source.

Cause and effect could be concealed, could be blurred, but as long as it existed, it could be felt.

But now?

The Nine Phoenix Saint truly felt the cause and effect connection to the Shadow Demon Great Saint sever and vanish, leaving not a single trace.

There were only two possibilities for this scene.

One was that the Shadow Demon Great Saint had truly perished.

The second was that the Shadow Demon Great Saint had abandoned everything to reincarnate.

“Galaxy Great Saint, the Shadow Demon he…” The Nine Phoenix Great Saint showed no fear, instead looking directly at Lin Yuan.

“Already completely dead.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Nine Phoenix Great Saint, similarly locking onto all things related to her cause and effect, needing only a thought to extinguish her entirely.

“Dead, dead…hahahahaha, dead and well, dead and well!”

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint suddenly burst into hysterical laughter; the scene she dreamed of witnessing had indeed happened now.

“Thank you, Galaxy Great Saint.”

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s demeanor gradually calmed, with a trace of tranquility and liberation, “Now, I won’t need the Galaxy Great Saint to take action.”

As the words fell.

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint burned completely.

Their body, soul, and mind began to blaze.

Not only her true self but also everything related to her cause and effect life-saving means began to burn.

“Ah Brother, Ah Sister, I’m coming to join you.”

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint, enveloped in infinitely vital flames, walked towards complete annihilation.
